Grace —

Quick from the LumenHealth AE thread: Sarah Blake said the project cut average inference latency from ~420ms to ~120ms on their primary endpoint after we enabled KV caching and switched to the q4b quant config. Short quote I pulled from her note: "Redwood made our model responses feel realtime to clinicians." (she used the word 'realtime').

Metric we can use: latency improvement: 71% (420->120ms), peak throughput: +3.5x during morning shift (from internal runbook). Source: LumenHealth SRE report (sre-logs-202601). I can attach the SRE excerpt if you want.

Attachment: LumenHealth_quote_short.txt

I can ping Sarah for explicit permission to use the quote; she was positive last month. If you want me to take point on that outreach, say so.
